candidate.title: LIANTI
candidate.scope: The LIANTI row of the supplied Illumina single-cell schematic: Linear Amplification via Transposon Insertion of single-cell genomic DNA, from lysis through barcoded double-stranded DNA amplicons. The transposome inset is a reagent/component explanation within this workflow. Neighboring Nuc-Seq/SNES and sci-DNA-Seq rows are context, not alternative targets of this LIANTI card. The primary paper clarifies promoter maturation and the genomic readout; unshown applications and subsequent DNA library preparation are not added as workflow branches.

operations.description: The released gDNA is randomly fragmented and tagged by the LIANTI transposome, producing genomic fragments bearing T7-promoter-containing transposon DNA at their ends.

operations.label: Linear amplification of gDNA significantly reduces amplification bias and replication errors
operations.description: T7 RNA polymerase transcribes the tagged gDNA into genomic RNA copies. gDNA serves as a reusable template; it is not chemically converted into RNA. The single RNA icon summarizes the amplification products.
operations.mechanism: T7-promoter-directed in vitro transcription provides linear amplification. The paper describes the RNA products as capable of self-priming at their 3′ ends.
operations.information_effect: Genomic sequence information is copied into RNA amplification intermediates. The caption describes reduced bias and replication errors; residual fragment-dependent amplification noise remains in the paper.

operations.label: RNase digestion and 2nd strand cDNA synthesis and UMI barcoding
operations.description: The cDNA/RNA hybrid undergoes RNA digestion and second-strand DNA synthesis, yielding double-stranded LIANTI DNA amplicons. The caption groups UMI barcoding into this final block, and the endpoint marks UMI at a terminal tag; the drawing does not resolve the barcode incorporation chemistry into separate reactions.
operations.mechanism: RNase removes the RNA component and second-strand synthesis makes the DNA duplex. The primary caption confirms unique molecular barcodes on the resulting amplicons.
operations.information_effect: The DNA product carries the original cell's genomic sequence into downstream DNA library preparation and sequencing. The paper describes CNV inference by counting original fragments grouped by mapped start/end coordinates; the UMI icon alone does not specify that analysis. Residual amplification noise and lysis-associated false SNVs limit perfect genome reconstruction.

method_scopes.rationale: The card title and middle-row label both identify LIANTI. The Chen et al. paper explicitly describes the same Tn5/T7 single-cell whole-genome amplification architecture. All six local operations apply to this schematic implementation. The early Genome icon is descriptive, the transposome inset defines the reagent, and the main row has one route without a pooling branch. The gap-extension interpretation at o_promoter is explicitly paper-supported; it is not claimed to be a visible label.
